observations: Photo 0 shows one blue, foot-mounted industrial speed reducer with a round cycloidal-style housing, a bolted mounting base and a steel output shaft on the right.
A large round flange is on the left, at the edge of the frame; no electric motor body is visible bolted to it.
A small black nameplate is fixed on the top of the housing but its text is unreadable at this resolution.
A lifting eye and bolt heads are on the housing; the paint is bright, even and fresh, covering bolts and plate edges, which suggests a recent repaint.
The output shaft is bare steel with light surface rust; no keyway close-up.
The unit sits on bare soil outdoors; a cable lies in front of it but is not connected to anything visible.
Photo carries a 'Posted on Jiji' stamp and a dealer watermark 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL'.
No clip of it running, no ratio, power or brand readable.
